subject: Audit logs: data access evidence & export request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alessandra Rossi <alessandra.rossi@fincobank.com>, Tom Walker <tom.walker@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Audit logs scope + next steps

Hi Alessandra / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps: 

- Scope: You asked for evidence showing who accessed what data and when (data access audit logs) across the Redwood inference console and any exported artifacts.
- Time window: You requested 24 months of access history (Jan 2024 — Mar 2026) — please confirm if you need full 24 months or a narrower window.
- Format: We suggested CSV + JSON exports (we can provide both).
- PII concerns: You mentioned redaction/PII masking requirements for exported logs — please confirm which fields you consider PII so we can mask or hash them in the export.
- Delivery: We can provide a presigned S3 link, secure SFTP, or scoped Drive folder; let us know your preference.

Next steps: 
1) Alessandra / Tom: confirm the exact time window, preferred export format, and any fields that must be redacted.
2) We'll loop in our Security/Engineering team to prepare the export and a short README describing schema and retention policy.
3) Target delivery: provisional within 3 business days after we have the exact scope.

Looping in Ben (security lead) and Marissa (your account lead) to coordinate.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: none

From: Alessandra Rossi <alessandra.rossi@fincobank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Walker <tom.walker@fincobank.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Audit logs scope + next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the recap. Confirming FinCoBank needs the following for our audit review: 

- Deliverable: Raw access audit logs showing who (user/service) accessed which resource, action taken, timestamp, originating IP, and session id / request id.
- Time window: Full 24 months (2024-03-01 to 2026-03-01).
- Export formats: CSV preferred for ingestion into our tooling; JSON acceptable as supplemental.
- PII: Please do NOT include raw customer PII (email addresses, SSNs, credit card numbers). We need identifiers that allow us to map events to internal users (e.g., hashed user_id or internal user id). If mapping tables are required, we can sign an NDA or execute a data-sharing addendum.
- Retention policy: Please include a short statement of Redwood's audit log retention policy and any options for extended retention (24+ months).
- Evidence: If possible, include a sample of the export (first 100 rows) and a README documenting column descriptions and timezone.

For delivery, presigned S3 link or secure SFTP is fine. We prefer company-controlled transfer (S3) with expiration.

Can Ben/Marissa confirm timelines and whether you need any paperwork before export?

Thanks,
Alessandra Rossi
Director, Security Governance | FinCoBank
alessandra.rossi@fincobank.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alessandra Rossi <alessandra.rossi@fincobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Walker <tom.walker@fincobank.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Audit logs scope + next steps

Thanks Alessandra — that scope is clear and doable. Looping Ben to confirm technical details and delivery timeline.

Ben / Marissa — here's what FinCoBank is asking for: 24 months (2024-03-01 -> 2026-03-01) of access audit logs showing: timestamp (ISO8601), actor (user_id or hashed identifier), action (read/write/export/login), resource (model id / dataset id / config), ip_address, request_id/session_id, and any error codes. They prefer CSV; JSON is optional. They do NOT want raw PII in the export.

Proposed approach: 
- We will produce a CSV export with the columns above. For actor identifiers, we will include internal user_id (hashed) by default; if FinCoBank signs a data-sharing addendum we can include mapping material.
- Retention: Standard offering keeps audit logs for 12 months, but for enterprise customers we can provide extended retention exports (24 months) as a one-off data export.
- Delivery: Provide a presigned S3 link (7-day expiry) containing: 
   - audit_logs_20240301_20260301.csv (full export)
   - README_audit_logs.txt (schema + timezone + hashing description)
   - sample_first_100_rows.csv (first 100 rows redacted/masked)

Target timeline: We can stage the export and share the link within 48-72 hours after Ben confirms availability and any legal prerequisites.

Ben — can you confirm you can produce the export on this timeline and whether we need any paperwork (SDA / DSA) before we hand over mapping tables?

Marissa — I'll update the FinCoBank opportunity in HubSpot and include the deliverables.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alessandra Rossi <alessandra.rossi@fincobank.com>, Tom Walker <tom.walker@fincobank.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit logs: data access evidence & export request

Jordan / team —

We can produce the requested export. A few implementation notes and confirmations: 

1) Export contents & format: We'll generate a CSV with the following header: timestamp,actor_id_hashed,action,resource,ip_address,request_id,error_code
   - actor_id_hashed uses HMAC-SHA256 with a per-customer salt (we will document hashing in README).
   - We will not include any raw customer PII.

2) Retention & coverage: Our standard retention window stored in-platform is 12 months. For FinCoBank we will assemble a 24-month export by combining on-platform logs and cold storage snapshots (full coverage 2024-03-01 -> 2026-03-01).

3) Delivery & attachments: We'll stage the files to a presigned S3 bucket. Draft filenames: 
   - audit_logs_20240301_20260301.csv (full export)
   - sample_first_100_rows.csv (redacted)
   - README_audit_logs.txt

Attachment: audit_logs_20240301_20260301.csv (CSV)

4) Legal / paperwork: If FinCoBank needs mapping to correlate hashed actor ids with their internal users, we will require a signed Data Sharing Addendum (DSA) or NDA. Otherwise we will only provide hashed identifiers.

5) Timeline: Assuming no paperwork needed for mapping, we can stage the export within 48 hours. If DSA is required, timeline depends on legal.

I'll prepare the export and post the presigned S3 link to this thread once ready.

Ben Carter
Security Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
--
Attachment stub: audit_logs_20240301_20260301.csv (CSV, 1.9GB)
